authority.sourceTitle: THC Cannabis Encyclopedia — Master 420-Entry Content Map v1.1 — CONTROLLED

parts.title: Botanical Identity and Morphology
parts.scope: Establishes the accepted botanical identity of Cannabis sativa L. and the structures used throughout the encyclopedia.

parts.title: Seed Biology, Germination, and Seedlings
parts.scope: Explains seed formation, viability, germination physiology, emergence, and the transition to an established seedling.

parts.title: Roots, Rhizosphere, and Growing Media
parts.scope: Connects root anatomy and microbial ecology to the physical and chemical properties of soil, soilless media, and hydroponic systems.

parts.title: Whole-Plant Physiology
parts.scope: Builds the physiological foundation for photosynthesis, respiration, transport, growth regulation, and source-sink relationships.

parts.title: Water Relations and Environmental Control
parts.scope: Explains how temperature, humidity, VPD, airflow, carbon dioxide, and substrate water status interact at the leaf and whole-plant level.

parts.title: Lighting and Photobiology
parts.scope: Covers light measurement, plant photoreceptors, photoperiod, spectrum, intensity, uniformity, and evidence-based lighting decisions.

parts.title: Mineral Nutrition and Root-Zone Chemistry
parts.scope: Explains essential elements, pH, EC, alkalinity, nutrient interactions, testing methods, and cautious diagnostic logic.

parts.title: Genetics, Genomics, Chemotype, and Sex
parts.scope: Connects inheritance and genomic variation to plant phenotype, chemical profile, sex expression, and cultivar identity.

parts.title: Clonal Propagation, Tissue Culture, and Germplasm
parts.scope: Covers vegetative propagation biology, mother-stock management, pathogen risk, micropropagation, acclimation, and preservation.

parts.title: Canopy Architecture and Training Biology
parts.scope: Explains how spacing, pruning, bending, trellising, and leaf-area decisions alter architecture, light capture, airflow, and recovery.

parts.title: Flowering, Reproduction, and Pollen Biology
parts.scope: Covers floral induction, reproductive development, pollen behavior, fertilization, seed production, and contamination control.

parts.title: Trichomes and Cannabinoid Biosynthesis
parts.scope: Examines gland development, cannabinoid-acid pathways, chemotype expression, maturation, degradation, and measurement limits.

parts.title: Terpenes, Volatiles, and Other Secondary Metabolites
parts.scope: Explains terpene biosynthesis and volatility while separating chemical evidence from unsupported aroma, synergy, or effect claims.

parts.title: Abiotic Disorders and Diagnostic Reasoning
parts.scope: Builds a repeatable differential-diagnosis process for environmental, water, light, nutrition, root-zone, and mechanical disorders.

parts.title: Arthropod and Invertebrate Pests
parts.scope: Provides identification, life-cycle, injury-pattern, scouting, and prevention knowledge without making unlawful pesticide recommendations.

parts.title: Diseases, Viroids, and Microbial Ecology
parts.scope: Covers infectious disease biology, diagnostic uncertainty, favorable environments, testing, containment, and crop-loss documentation.

parts.title: Integrated Pest Management, Biosecurity, and Sanitation
parts.scope: Turns pest and disease knowledge into prevention, exclusion, scouting, decision, response, verification, and lawful-control systems.

parts.title: Harvest and Postharvest Plant Material Science
parts.scope: Explains maturity assessment, harvest handling, water removal, water activity, curing, storage, and quality preservation.

parts.title: Outdoor, Greenhouse, and Protected Cultivation Ecology
parts.scope: Applies plant science to site selection, natural climate, soil, irrigation, weather, wildlife, pollen, and protected structures.

parts.title: Breeding, Selection, and Genetic Conservation
parts.scope: Builds an evidence-based breeding system using defined objectives, controlled crosses, adequate populations, replication, and traceable records.

parts.title: Measurement, Data Systems, Quality, and Research Literacy
parts.scope: Creates the measurement and documentation layer that makes every observation, procedure, lesson, and claim auditable.
